$comment: The Lost Art of Closing (Iannarino, 2017) — probes. Closing = rangkaian komitmen kecil (10 tahap), bukan satu momen. Target: C6.4.

probes.text: After a good conversation with a prospective client, do you always get a specific commitment for the NEXT step (date, action, person) before ending the conversation?

signal_interpretation.positive: Every conversation ends with a clear next commitment — the pipeline moves
signal_interpretation.negative: The conversation ends with "I'll let you know later" and no next step — a dangling lead.

probes.text: Setiap kali memberi sesuatu (info rincian, konsultasi, revisi kecil), apakah Anda meminta imbalan komitmen — atau memberi gratis saja?

signal_interpretation.positive: Trading value: setiap pemberian diganti komitmen — momentum terjaga
signal_interpretation.negative: Semua diberi gratis — pembeli tak berkomitmen, harga makin diperdebatkan

probes.text: From a 'hanging' lead, do you know EXACTLY what commitment they last fulfilled — and what small commitment hasn't been asked of them?

signal_interpretation.positive: Posisi tiap lead di tangga komitmen diketahui + langkah berikutnya jelas
signal_interpretation.negative: Tidak tahu posisi lead — tidak ada tangga komitmen sama sekali
signal_interpretation.neutral: Tahu kasus per kasus tanpa tangga baku

probes.text: When a prospective client hesitates or has objections, do you schedule a dedicated time to discuss them until they’re fully resolved — or wait for them to work through it on their own?

signal_interpretation.positive: Keberatan dijadwalkan & diselesaikan (commitment to resolve concerns)
signal_interpretation.negative: Keberatan dibiarkan mengendap sampai deal mati
